snippet.title: The Parish Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Parish is a slow burning retro horror game out on the 24th of October
Tend a remote church, give services to the needy and you never know... you might just survive the night

Do you tell your friends that you like ALL games... time to prove it!

Available on itch: https://colranestudios.itch.io/

And Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172480/The_Parish/
